newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE UNITED V MONACO TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEWCASTLE UNITED V MONACO TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Tuesday's UEFA Cup quarter-final first leg match between England's Newcastle United and Monaco of the French league.
Newcastle -15-Shaka Hislop, 19-Steve Watson, 5-Darren Peacock, 12-Philippe Albert, 21-Robbie Elliott, 18-Keith Gillespie, 4-David Batty, 2-Warren Barton, 7-Robert Lee, 20-Lee Clarke, 14-David Ginola.

Monaco - 1-Fabien Barthez, 19-Lilian Martin, 5-Franck Dumas, 18-Gilles Grimandi, 2-Patrick Blondeau, 4-Martin Djetou, 15-Sylvain Legwinski, 7-John Collins, 9-Andersen, 8-Ali Benarbia, 28-Thierry Henry.
